[{"insert":"Low Incline DB Bench Press

The low incline dumbbell bench sits just above flat, which keeps most of the work on your mid chest while also hitting the upper chest. Dumbbells let each arm move on its own path, which is easier on the shoulders than a barbell. Lower under control and press the dumbbells together at the top. The last set is max unbroken reps, so save some gas for it.
"}]
